description: This file defines the AppRouter class responsible for managing navigation routes within a Flutter application. It contains route constants and a static method to handle route generation based on route names, returning MaterialPageRoute instances. It references various screen widgets for splash, login, and home screens.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: A utility class providing route constants and a static method for route generation in the app.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: A static method that returns a route based on the RouteSettings; centralizes navigation logic.

methods.name: _page
methods.description: A private static helper method that creates a MaterialPageRoute for a given Widget.
